caption: The drawing depicts an elaborate historical dress without a visible wearer, displayed on a blank mannequin outline. The dress is primarily pale yellow or cream-colored, featuring a fitted bodice with a low neckline trimmed in a greyish-blue lace, and sleeves ending below the elbow, also adorned with lace. The bodice and sleeves are decorated with pink, red, yellow, and purple floral patterns with green leaves. The skirt is composed of two layers: an upper, open-front overskirt of the same pale yellow fabric, also embellished with matching floral designs, and an underskirt with detailed line work suggesting embroidered patterns, mostly consisting of circular floral motifs outlined in fine black or grey lines. Ribbons or bows appear at the shoulder and elbow, matching the lace trim. The left bottom side of the dress includes a visible shoe of the same pale yellow color, also decorated with a small floral motif. Off to the right background, there is a smaller, faint sketch of the same dress viewed from the back, showing the rear draping and overall form. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Wedding Dress
